item.title: 2026-11-22 — Rutte vows to defend Poland, tankers hit near Hormuz, Leeds rout Chelsea and England thrash the All Blacks
item.description:
Nato's Mark Rutte went to Warsaw to pledge Poland's defence after Russian missiles landed on Polish soil, while two tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz. We take stock of Wall Street's worst week in more than eighteen months and preview a packed Thanksgiving week. Plus actively exploited flaws in Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway and VMware vCenter, and a Saturday of shocks from Stamford Bridge to Twickenham.

item.title: 2026-11-21 — Nvidia plunges 14% as S&P 500 and Dow enter correction, Russian missiles land in Poland, UK and EU seal reset deal
item.description:
Wall Street's AI sell-off deepened on Friday: Nvidia fell 14 per cent, the S&P 500 and Dow closed in correction and the Nasdaq wiped out its gains for the year. Russian missiles and a drone came down in Poland during a huge attack on Ukraine, and the UK and EU agreed a package of post-Brexit deals in Brussels. Plus JPMorgan Chase's vendor breach, the Optimizely fallout, and a big sporting weekend from St James' Park to Las Vegas.

item.title: 2026-11-20 — Anthropic soars 17% in debut as AI sell-off sinks markets, Trump-Xi-Putin summit yields no breakthrough
item.description:

item.title: 2026-11-19 — Anthropic's record IPO debut, Trump-Xi-Putin talks in China, Iran widens Gulf attacks
item.description:
Anthropic prices the biggest IPO on record at 83 dollars a share ahead of its Nasdaq debut, as hawkish Fed minutes push the dollar to a 19-month high and gold to a 14-month low. Trump, Xi and Putin prepare for three-way talks at APEC in Shenzhen while Iran strikes at Kuwait and Bahrain after a US strike on Qeshm Island. Plus Maersk confirms a breach, an exploited Puppet Enterprise flaw, and Pochettino's first day at Manchester United.
